decoder.name: Key-press CNN + en char 6-gram beam (Fidetype)
decoder.weights_licence: not released (trained on CC BY 4.0 data)
training_data: Tatoeba en (CC BY 2.0 FR) for the char LM

policy.name: trust gate + CRC
policy.description: commit threshold by conformal risk control, alpha 0.05

shuffled.basis: aggregate null audit (n=200): wrong-commit real 0.875 vs frame-shuffled 1.000

zeros.basis: aggregate null audit: wrong-commit real 0.875 vs zeros input 1.000

guarantee.scope: marginal wrong-commit rate over test sentences; exchangeable; the bound covers the pool (all participants together), not each participant: one participant can be worse (trust guarantee section 4: https://github.com/zhangzibo/fidetype/blob/main/docs/trust-guarantee.md#4-what-is-not-guaranteed)
guarantee.calibration_split: cal (held-out half of the fit items)

conformance.checked: local composed streams (cache streams/calib/test00_ctc.npz); provenance fails only on decoder.weights_sha256 and stream.id

notes: Composed sentences from isolated key presses: not natural typing.

2026-11-25: the scope line now says that the bound covers the pool of all participants, not each participant (trust guarantee section 4). Basis: the pooled-guard check (commit 74a21f8; https://github.com/zhangzibo/fidetype/blob/main/experiments/2026-11-25-pooled-guard-check/results.md). No number changed.

safe_wpm.calibration: cal (held-out half of the fit items)
safe_wpm.timing: track rate model: len(truth) * 60 / 75.76 chars/min (composed sentences)

correction_rule.name: rewrite
correction_rule.formula: 2 s + 0.7895 s/char * len(truth) per wrong commit

safe_wpm.no_bci_note: gaze typing of every sentence at 20 chars/min (the eWPM reference)

basis.shuffled: aggregate null audit (n=200): wrong-commit real 0.875 vs frame-shuffled 1.000
basis.zeros: aggregate null audit: wrong-commit real 0.875 vs zeros input 1.000

safe_wpm.basis: exact per-trial CRC decisions (P6-01 rerun of the M6-07 pipeline; commit and wrong-commit rates equal the committed aggregates)

safe_wpm_v02.definition_status: adopted 2026-11-22: the headline metric (prefix credit + the aac-gaze-v1 reading cost); safe-wpm/0.1 stays selectable with metric_version='0.1' for old numbers
safe_wpm_v02.calibration: cal (held-out half of the fit items)
safe_wpm_v02.timing: track rate model: len(truth) * 60 / 75.76 chars/min (composed sentences)

correction_rule.name: rewrite
correction_rule.formula: 2 s + 0.7895 s/char * len(truth) per wrong commit
correction_rule.prefix: a wrong prefix of k words costs the penalty of the first k words of the truth

reading_cost.formula: 0.5 s + 0.3 s/word * k per commit (right or wrong); prefix commits with fewer than 1 word(s) count as no commit
reading_cost.note: the adopted safe-wpm/0.2 reading cost (2026-11-22) is 0.5 s + 0.3 s/word per commit, minimum prefix 1 word; other values give a sensitivity variant
